share.start.title: Share with everyone in {tenant}?
share.start.body: Every member of {tenant} will find this conversation under “Shared with me”, and can read it or copy it into a conversation of their own. They can't ask in it, rename it or delete it.
share.start.warning: The answers were produced with your permissions and may contain data other members can't normally see. Stopping sharing or deleting the conversation doesn't take back copies that members already made.
share.stop.title: Stop sharing this conversation?
share.stop.body: Shared with every member of {tenant} since {time}. Once you stop, it disappears from their “Shared with me” list and they can no longer read it.
share.stop.warning: Stopping sharing doesn't take back copies that members already made: each copy is a conversation of its own and stays. Deleting this conversation doesn't take them back either.

share.message.stopped: Stopped sharing. Copies that members already made stay.

share.not_found.body: This conversation isn't shared with you (any more), doesn't exist, or was deleted. Copies made earlier stay in your own conversations.

certificate_renewal.bindings_stale: The certificate authority's gateway bindings may be out of date. Try again later.
certificate_renewal.ca_not_ready: The certificate authority can't renew certificates yet. Try again in a few minutes.

page.home.title: Home
page.login.title: Sign in to TrustIoT
page.login.email_intro: Enter your email address and we'll send you a sign-in code.

page.login.code_hint: Enter the {length} digits from the email.

page.login.resend_in: Send a new code in {seconds} s
page.login.resent: We sent a new code to {email}.
gateways.title: Gateways
gateways.description: TrustIoT gateways on site read your devices and send the data to the cloud.
gateways.health_failed: Couldn't load the devices and health: {reason}
gateways.stale: Can't refresh right now. This is the state at {time}. It keeps retrying.
gateways.summary.label: Status summary
gateways.no_match.title: No gateway has this status.
gateways.caption: Gateways, {count} in total
gateways.details.heading: Operating metrics from the latest heartbeat ({time}).
gateways.details.none: This gateway has not reported operating metrics yet.
gateways.details.unavailable: The health data could not be loaded.
gateways.empty.title: No gateway is bound yet
gateways.empty.body: A gateway is the box on site that reads your devices. Bind it to this organization, and you can add devices.
gateways.empty.need: You need the hardware ID and the claim code on the gateway's label.
gateways.empty.viewer: Binding a gateway needs an administrator. Ask an administrator of {tenant} to bind one, and it will appear here.
gateways.bind.title: Bind a gateway
gateways.bind.description: Once bound, this gateway belongs only to {tenant}, and all the data it reads comes here.
gateways.bind.hardware_hint: Printed on the label under the gateway, and on the box.
gateways.bind.hardware_invalid: A hardware ID has letters, digits, dots, hyphens and underscores only, and is at most 64 characters.
gateways.bind.claim_hint: Printed on the same label as the hardware ID. It proves the gateway is in your hands.
gateways.bind.rejected_body: The hardware ID and the claim code don't match, or this gateway can't be bound right now. Check the two codes on the label and try again. If it still fails, contact support and give the hardware ID.
gateways.bind.network_body: Couldn't reach the server. What you typed is kept. Just try again; the gateway is never bound twice.
gateways.bind.limited_body: To stop anyone from guessing hardware IDs, binding is paused. Try again in {time}.
gateways.bind.quota_body: Your plan allows no more gateways. Existing gateways keep working. Reload the page to see the plan and what is used.
gateways.bound.title: Bound {gateway}
gateways.bound.body: Once it has power and a network connection, a gateway usually comes online within 2 minutes, and this page updates by itself. You can add its devices before then.
gateways.quota.title: The {plan} plan's gateway limit is reached ({used} / {limit})
gateways.quota.body_upgrade: Existing gateways keep working; you just can't add more. {plan} allows {allowance}. To upgrade, contact us.
gateways.quota.body_top: Existing gateways keep working; you just can't add more. To raise the limit, contact us.
gateways.quota.allowance_enterprise: a gateway count set by contract
page.login.signed_out_everywhere: You signed out on all your devices.
page.login.sign_out_everywhere_unfinishe: Your other devices aren't signed out yet: this session had already ended, so signing out of all devices didn't go through. Sign in, then choose Sign out of all devices again.
page.login.cookie_missing: You signed in, but this browser didn't keep the sign-in. Allow cookies for this site and try again.

page.not_found.body: The page {path} doesn't exist or has moved.
page.forbidden.title: No permission
page.forbidden.body: Your role doesn't allow access to this page. Ask an administrator of your organization.
page.tenant_suspended.title: Organization suspended
page.tenant_suspended.body: This organization has been suspended. Contact your administrator.
page.tenant_suspended.named_body: {name} has been suspended, so its data and devices can't be used right now. Contact your organization's administrator.
page.tenant_suspended.other_tenants: You can continue in another organization:
page.unavailable.title: Service temporarily unavailable
page.unavailable.body: TrustIoT can't be reached right now. This is usually brief.
page.error.title: Something went wrong
page.error.body: The page could not be shown.
device.not_found.title: Device not found
device.not_found.body: {tenant} has no device with this address. It may have been removed, or it belongs to another organization: switch organizations in the top bar to look there.
device.model_failed: The device's model couldn't be loaded, so data points are listed by key only: {reason}
device.latest.title: Current readings
device.latest.failed: The latest values couldn't be loaded: {reason}
device.latest.no_points_title: Model {model} has no data points yet
device.latest.no_points_body: The gateway reads only the data points defined in the model. Once the model has some, the stored readings appear here and can be charted.
device.history.title: History of {point}
device.history.custom_hint: Times are in your time zone ({zone}); change it in your settings.
device.history.from_invalid: Enter the start date and time.
device.history.to_invalid: Enter the end date and time.
device.history.order_invalid: The end must be after the start.
device.history.no_points_body: The chart shows one data point of the device's model. Once the model has data points and readings are stored, choose one here.
device.history.outside_title: This range is outside the queryable period
device.history.outside_body: Stored history can be queried from {earliest} on, and the whole range you chose ({from} – {to}) is before that. Choose a more recent range.
device.history.truncated: The range starts before the queryable period, so the chart starts at {earliest}, the earliest data that can be queried.
device.history.empty_body: Nothing was stored for {point} between {from} and {to}. Choose a longer range, or check that the gateway is online and the device reports this data point.
device.history.chart_label: Chart of {point} from {from} to {to}. Use the arrow keys to read each interval.
device.stale.title: No new readings for {duration}
device.stale.body: The last reading was stored at {time}. This device is polled every {poll}, so it does not usually go this long without data. Check that gateway {gateway} has power and a network connection, and that the device at {address} is reachable.
device.info.title: Device information
device.never.title: No readings from this device yet
device.never.body: Nothing was stored since {earliest}. The first reading usually shows up within a minute of adding a device. Check in this order:
device.never.step_model: The addresses of the data points in model {model} match the device's manual.
device.history.legend_on_share: Share of readings that were on, per {interval}
device.history.text_note: {point} holds text, so it is not drawn as a chart. The table merges consecutive intervals whose last reading is the same text into one row.
device.history.period_caption: Values of {point} and how long each lasted
devices.title: Devices
devices.description: Modbus devices your gateways poll. Open a device for its latest values and chart.
devices.models_failed: The model names couldn't be loaded, so devices show no model and the model filter is empty: {reason}
devices.caption: Devices, {count} in total
devices.search.label: Search devices
devices.no_match.title: No device matches
devices.no_match.body: Try another word, or clear the filters.
devices.setup.title: No devices yet
devices.setup.body: Device data reaches TrustIoT through a gateway. Follow these steps, and you can ask the AI about your devices in a conversation.
devices.setup.step_model_body: A model describes which registers to read and how to convert them. You can import one from JSON exported from another organization.
devices.flash.created: The device {name} was added. Its gateway gets the new configuration version.
device_delete.title: Delete the device {name}?
device_delete.body: The gateway gets a new configuration version and stops reading this device. Data already received is kept until its retention period ends, but the device leaves the list; a device with the same name can be created again later.
device_form.new_description: After you add it, the gateway gets a new configuration version and usually starts reading within a minute.
device_form.settings_description: Change how the gateway reaches this device and how often it reads it.
device_form.denied_body: Your role in {tenant} is viewer. To add or change devices, ask an editor or an administrator.
device_form.name: Name
device_form.name_hint: Lowercase letters and digits with single hyphens, 1 to 40 characters. It can't be changed later.
device_form.no_gateways: Your organization has no bound gateway yet. Bind one first; a device is read by a gateway.
device_form.gateway_unlisted: The gateway {gateway} is not among your bound gateways, so the service will refuse it.
device_form.fixed_hint: Can't be changed after the device is created.
device_form.connection_hint: How the gateway reaches the device.
device_form.transport.tcp_hint: The device has a network port itself.
device_form.transport.rtu_hint: An RS485 device behind a converter. Devices behind one converter share its connection and each has its own unit ID.
device_form.host_hint: The IP address or domain name of the device or converter.
device_form.poll_hint: Your plan ({plan}) allows polling as often as every {duration}. Shorter intervals come with a higher plan.
device_form.poll_hint_unknown: The shortest interval your plan allows couldn't be read; the service refuses an interval below it.
device_form.saved: Saved. The device is at revision {revision}.
device_form.ended_body: The gateway this device belongs to was unbound, so the device can't be changed any more. You can only delete it. Its data can still be viewed on the device page.
device_form.conflict_title: Someone else changed this device (it is now at revision {revision})
device_form.conflict_body: Your changes are not saved. Reload to see the latest settings; your changes are listed beside them, and you can save again after you check.
device_form.reloaded_same: The latest settings are the same as yours.
model_edit.new_description: A model says which registers a gateway reads and how it converts them to values.
model_edit.not_found_body: {tenant} has no model with this address. It may have been deleted, or it belongs to another organization: switch organizations in the top bar to look there.
model_edit.name: Name
model_edit.name_hint: Lowercase letters and digits with single hyphens, 1 to 40 characters. It can't be changed later.
model_edit.viewer_note: Your role is viewer: you can look at and export models, not change them.
model_edit.save_note: After you save, the {count} devices that use this model get a new configuration version; until a gateway applies it, it keeps reading with the old one.
model_edit.save_note_none: No device uses this model yet, so saving only updates the model.
model_edit.saved: Saved. The model is at revision {revision}.
model_edit.conflict_title: Someone else changed this model (it is now at revision {revision})
model_edit.conflict_body: Your changes are not saved. Reload to see the latest data points; the changes you made here are dropped, so write down what you need first.
model_edit.points_hint: The gateway reads them in this order. Addresses count from 0: 40001 in a manual is holding register address 0. Value = raw × scale + offset.
model_edit.no_points: This model has no data points yet.
model_delete.title: Delete the model {name}?
model_delete.body: This can't be undone. A JSON file you exported can be imported again later.
model_delete.in_use_body: Devices still use this model, so it can't be deleted. A device keeps its model, so delete those devices first.
models.title: Device models
models.description: A model says which registers a gateway reads and how it converts them to values. Many devices can share one model.
models.caption: Device models
models.empty.title: No device models yet
models.empty.body: A model describes which registers one kind of device is read from. Make one for the device you have most of; every device of that kind can share it.
models.empty.import_hint: If you have a model file exported from TrustIoT (.json), you can import it.
models.empty.viewer: Ask an editor or an administrator to create one.
model_import.title: Import a device model
model_import.body: Choose a model file exported from TrustIoT (.json). An import creates a new model and never replaces one.
model_import.invalid_shape: This file's name or data points don't have the shape of an exported model.
model_import.too_large: This file is larger than 1 MB, which is far more than a model needs.
model_import.preview.name: Model name
chat.composer.ask_placeholder: Ask about your devices, for example: how much energy did cooling tower 2 use this week?
chat.composer.continue_placeholder: Keep asking, for example: only look at tower 2
chat.composer.hint: Enter to send, Shift + Enter for a new line
chat.composer.stopped: Stopped. Nothing of this question was kept; it is back in the box if you want to change it or send it again.
chat.composer.ask_failed: The question was not sent: {reason} Your text is still in the box.
chat.composer.completion_hint: While you type, AI suggestions appear in grey: Tab accepts one, Esc dismisses it.
chat.composer.completion_paused: Suggestions paused, back in about {minutes} min
chat.composer.stopped_regenerated: Stopped. The answer you asked to replace was removed too. The question is back in the box if you want to change it or send it again.
chat.composer.regenerate_gone: The answer you asked to replace was removed. Your question is back in the box; send it to ask again.
chat.regenerate.stale: This conversation changed since you opened it, so it is shown as it is now. Nothing was removed. Regenerate again if you still want a new answer.
chat.regenerate.discarded: Couldn't regenerate the answer: {reason} The old answer was already removed. Your question is back in the box; send it to ask again.

chat.mention.at_button: Mention a device, data point, model or time range (@)
chat.mention.none_body: {tenant} has no device, data point or model with that in its name. Try another word, or describe it in words.
chat.mention.none_body_empty: {tenant} has no devices, data points or models of this kind yet.
chat.mention.error_title: The lists could not be looked up
chat.mention.error_body: The connection dropped or the service is unavailable. Time ranges still work.
chat.template.none_body: Try another word, or type your question in words.
chat.template.error_title: The templates could not be loaded
chat.template.error_body: The connection dropped or the service is unavailable. You can still type your question.
conversations.delete.running: A question is being answered: deleting stops it, and its answer is not kept.
draft.list_failed: This conversation's drafts couldn't be loaded. {reason}
draft.meta.new: Only you can see it, here. No version of it is in the dashboard list yet.
draft.meta.saved: It comes from a dashboard in the list. Saving adds a new version to that dashboard.
draft.viewer: Only editors and admins can save drafts to the dashboard list. You can look at this one here.
draft.reader: This draft is in a conversation another member shared. You can only look at it: it can't be saved or changed here, and its data is queried with your own permissions, so you may see less than its owner does.
draft.saved.title: Saved as version {version} in the dashboard list
draft.saved.body: Everyone in your organization with access can see it now.
draft.preview_note: Draft preview: the data is queried live, and what you see is what the saved dashboard shows.
draft.saved_changed_hint: If you just saved this version, version {latest} of the saved dashboard is it.
answer_draft.unreadable: A dashboard this answer wrote can't be shown. {reason}

member.already_member: This email is already a member.

invitation.account_mismatch: This invitation was not sent to this account.

members.card.title: Members
members.card.caption: Members of {tenant}
members.empty.title: You're the only one in this organization
members.empty.body: Invite the people who work on the floor or in quality control, and they can see device data and ask the assistant. You can start with Viewer and change it later.
members.invitations.title: Pending invitations
members.invitations.description: The person accepts by signing in with this email; only then do they become a member. An invitation expires after 7 days.
members.help.title: What each role can do
members.help.last_admin: An organization always keeps at least one administrator.
members.role.label: Role
members.role.viewer_summary: Can see devices, data and dashboards, and use the assistant. Can't change settings.
members.role.editor_summary: Can also add and change devices, models, dashboards and alert rules.
members.role.admin_summary: Can also manage members, bind gateways and see the plan.
members.denied.title: Only administrators can manage members
members.denied.body: Your role in {tenant} is {role}. To invite colleagues or change roles, ask an administrator of the organization.
members.denied.body_admins: Your role in {tenant} is {role}. To invite colleagues or change roles, ask an administrator of the organization: {admins}.
members.invite.title: Invite a member
members.invite.description: They get an invitation by email. They join the organization after they sign in to TrustIoT with that email and accept.
members.role_dialog.title: Change {name}'s role
members.role_dialog.description: The change applies at once: the new role is used from their next request.
members.role_dialog.self_title: You will lose the right to manage members
members.role_dialog.self_body: After you lower your own role, only another administrator can change it back.
members.role_dialog.failed: The role could not be changed
members.remove.title: Remove {name} from {tenant}?
members.remove.body: {name} loses access to this organization at once; a signed-in session is refused from the next request. What they created (devices, dashboards, alert rules) stays. To join again they need a new invitation.
members.toast.invited_body: They appear in the member list once they accept.
members.toast.resent_body: The invitation is valid for another 7 days.
members.toast.revoked_body: The link in that email no longer works, and the seat is free again.
members.toast.role_changed_body: The new role applies from their next request.
members.toast.removed_body: They no longer have access to this organization.
members.accept.title: Join {tenant}
members.accept.invalid.title: This invitation can't be used
members.accept.invalid.body: It may have expired, been revoked, or been accepted already. If you haven't joined yet, ask the person who invited you to send it again.
members.accept.mismatch.title: This invitation wasn't sent to this account

members.accept.joined.body: The invitation is accepted, but the page couldn't open the organization. Go to the home page to continue.
